Earlier scenes:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

This scene:
他又聪明又努力，旅行很远找到很多植物。比方说，灵芝和夹竹桃。他一吃各种各样的植物就知道能不能吃这些植物。然后，神农写他的主意。他喜欢植物的味道，特别是花。神农遇到了一个黄色的花，一吃就觉得不舒服。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 然后，神农写他的主意：写下，他的发现

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 旅行很远：到很远的地方旅行，Use a destination phrase to show where the travel goes; the verb cannot use this distance phrase directly in this position. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 写他的主意：写下了自己的主意，Writing an idea down needs the resultative complement in order to show that it was recorded; use the reflexive possessor because the ideas belong to the subject. [rule: resultative_complement]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 遇到了一个黄色的花：看到了一朵黄色的花，Use the classifier for flowers, and use the resultative form to show that he saw the flower. [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 然后，神农写他的主意：然后，他写下了自己的主意，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the same character was mentioned in the previous sentence and no other character competes as the referent. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农遇到了一个黄色的花：他看到了一朵黄色的花，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence of the same character. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到很多植物：找到了很多植物，The final action in this series is completed, so it needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “旅行很远” is an acceptable way to say that someone travelled a great distance.
The needed correction is “写下自己的发现”; the system leaves the inappropriate object “主意” in place.
“一个……花” uses the wrong measure word, and “看到了一朵黄色的花” is correct Chinese.
A close re-reference to 神农 should use 他, but the displayed correction still retains the teacher-marked problem with “主意”.
神农 is a close re-occurrence with no competing referent, so 他 is required under the teacher’s reference rule.
找到 is the final completed action in this action sequence and should take 了.
